about.description:
caveman is a Claude Code skill that cuts ~65% of tokens by talking like
caveman. This package installs the `caveman` CLI, a one-shot bootstrapper
that auto-detects supported AI coding agents on the machine (Claude Code,
Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, opencode, Continue, Cline, Windsurf, and
~25 more) and runs each agent's native install path. It also wires
Claude Code hooks, a statusline badge, and the `caveman-shrink` MCP
middleware when those targets are present. Idempotent and re-runnable.
about.summary: One-shot installer that wires the caveman Claude Code skill into ~30 AI coding agents

raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.4.0"

package:
  # Upstream npm `name` is `caveman-installer`; both `caveman` slots (PyPI + npm)
  # are taken by unrelated dormant projects, so we keep the upstream name here.
  # The installed CLI is `caveman-install` (per package.json `bin` map).
  name: caveman-installer
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3e487f5b3b0916cc5594f2bf4973b47cf5711995be68eae4ae92f4698444756f

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - if: unix
      then:
        - set -ex
        - NPM_VER=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
        - pnpm install --prod --ignore-scripts
        - pnpm-licenses generate-disclaimer --prod --output-file=ThirdPartyLicenses.txt
        - npm pack --ignore-scripts --userconfig nonexistentrc
        - npm install --userconfig nonexistentrc --global "${SRC_DIR}/caveman-installer-${NPM_VER}.tgz"
        - find "${PREFIX}/lib/node_modules/caveman-installer" -type d -name .bin -exec rm -rf {} + || true
      else:
        - for /f "delims=" %%v in ('node -p "require('./package.json').version"') do set NPM_VER=%%v
        - call pnpm install --prod --ignore-scripts
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call pnpm-licenses generate-disclaimer --prod --output-file=ThirdPartyLicenses.txt
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call npm pack --ignore-scripts --userconfig nonexistentrc
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - call npm install --userconfig nonexistentrc --global "%SRC_DIR%/caveman-installer-%NPM_VER%.tgz"
        - if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
        - for /d /r "%PREFIX%\node_modules\caveman-installer" %%d in (.bin) do if exist "%%d" rd /s /q "%%d"

requirements:
  build:
    - nodejs >=18
    - pnpm
    - pnpm-licenses
  host:
    - nodejs >=18
  run:
    - nodejs >=18

tests:
  - script:
      - caveman-install --help

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - LICENSE.BSL
    - LICENSING.md
    - ThirdPartyLicenses.txt
  summary: One-shot installer that wires the caveman Claude Code skill into ~30 AI coding agents
  description: |
    caveman is a Claude Code skill that cuts ~65% of tokens by talking like
    caveman. This package installs the `caveman` CLI, a one-shot bootstrapper
    that auto-detects supported AI coding agents on the machine (Claude Code,
    Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, opencode, Continue, Cline, Windsurf, and
    ~25 more) and runs each agent's native install path. It also wires
    Claude Code hooks, a statusline badge, and the `caveman-shrink` MCP
    middleware when those targets are present. Idempotent and re-runnable.
  homepage: https://getcaveman.dev/
  repository: https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman
  documentation: https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman/blob/main/INSTALL.md

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - rxm7706
